title: Stone, sea and makers
intro: A gateway asks you to look closer. A painted panel invites a conversation. The shore leaves room to pause. Follow this thread from Bhubaneswar through Raghurajpur to Puri, and make space for the meals and people between.

chapters.title: Begin with a gateway. Stay for a meal.
chapters.text: At Mukteswar, give one carved detail your attention before trying to see everything. Carry that slower pace to the table: explore dalma, ask how it is made here, and leave room for the city beyond its monuments.
chapters.prompt: Before setting out, check entry arrangements, shade and seating at your chosen sites. Ask your meal provider about ingredients, preparation and the menu for your date.

chapters.title: Let the maker lead the conversation.
chapters.text: Arrive with a question, not just a camera. A Pattachitra panel can open a conversation about materials, a story or a particular hand at work. Give the person making it time to decide what they want to share.
chapters.prompt: Arrange a visit with a named maker; agree the time and any demonstration fee. Ask before photographing people or work, and discuss credit and purchase details directly.

chapters.title: Give the town and the shore their own time.
chapters.text: Puri holds several kinds of attention: a sacred meal, the life of the town, and a horizon that needs no itinerary. Read about Mahaprasad before planning that experience, then leave an unhurried space beside the sea.
chapters.prompt: Confirm temple entry eligibility and current arrangements before planning darshan or a meal. Check beach conditions locally. Compare a stay by its exact location, access and facilities, rather than a neighbourhood label alone.

preparation.title: Choose your season
preparation.text: Incredible India recommends October–February for Puri. Use that as a seasonal starting point, then check the forecast and any local advisories for your dates.

preparation.title: Make space between chapters
preparation.text: These chapters are a reading order, not a timed itinerary. Confirm transfers, opening arrangements and realistic breaks before assigning days. You can shorten the collection or add Dhauli from its guide.

preparation.title: Ask about access
preparation.text: Step-free approaches, accessible toilets, seating and suitable vehicles have not been confirmed for this trail. Ask each place or provider about the specific support you need.
